bibl.title: Jesus, Fishermen and Tax Collectors. Papyrology and the Construction of the Ancient Economy of Roman Palestine.
bibl.seg: John S. Kloppenborg, Jesus, Fishermen and Tax Collectors. Papyrology and the Construction of the Ancient Economy of Roman Palestine.
bibl.note: [Introduction: Comparison of the Galilean fishing industry with that of the Graeco-Egyptian industry as it is reflected in numerous documentary papyri offers several important conclusions about the organization and profitability of fishing]. - Material considerations. - Economic and legal considerations: Taxes on fishing; - Shore fishermen; - Boat taxes; - Lease of fishing rights. - Fishing in Roman Palestine.
